messages:
Mika: quick ping — PR #8539 (kv-shard-alloc) is green on unit tests but perf artifacts show longseq p99 +28% on canary workload. need consent to merge or extend canary. bench output:

Mika: ```
cmd: ./bench/run --workload=longseq --clients=64 --seq=8192
baseline p99: 180ms
pr p99: 230ms (+28%)
baseline p95: 110ms
pr p95: 115ms (+4%)
mem delta: +60MB avg
artifact: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/8539/2026-03-10
```

Sam: :eyes: thanks. that's mostly tail. is this reproducible on different seeds? can you paste per-shard breakdown?

Mika: attaching per-shard summary: ```shard0 p99 185ms; shard1 p99 220ms; shard2 p99 235ms``` looks concentrated on shard2.

Dina: shard2 correlates with KV-eviction change in PR. can we rerun with eviction disabled?

Mika: rerun queued: bench-bot kicked off.

bench-bot: Automated run completed: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/8539/rerun-1 - results: p99 188ms (close to baseline), shard2 p99 190ms. CPU same. seems eviction heuristic was causing the tail.

Alex: Nice. can we add a targeted unit/regression test for eviction churn? Also prefer to keep canary open for 2 hours to monitor.

Sam: I can +1 after a quick code read. @dina can you do a final glance for correctness? need 2 reviewers.

Dina: looking now, minor nits. will post comment by EOD. if no other issues, :thumbsup: to merge and canary for 2h.

Mika: thanks. setting merge window to next slot (in 30m) and will start 2h canary with health checks. I'll note rollback threshold: p99 delta > 15% or error-rate > 0.5%.

Alex: re: health checks - add a quick synthetic that hits the problematic shard keyspace.

Mika: done, added to canary config. will ping when canary starts. :rocket:

Sam: +1

bench-bot: Reminder: artifact retention policy will delete intermediate runs after 30d unless tagged.

Mika: tagged the rerun as 'keep' and added bench link to PR. thanks everyone.
